attacks.name: ARMageddon
attacks.impact: Cross-core cache attacks break ARM TrustZone on Android
attacks.mitigation: Cache partitioning
attacks.boundary_statement: ARMageddon breaks ARM TrustZone on default configured Android smartphones via cross-core cache attacks. No assigned CVE; TrustZone kernel-hardening concern.

attacks.name: AsyncShock
attacks.impact: Exploits UAF and TOCTTOU bugs in multithreaded SGX enclaves via controlled thread scheduling
attacks.mitigation: Disable multithreading in enclaves or harden synchronization primitives
attacks.boundary_statement: AsyncShock manipulates SGX enclave thread scheduling to reliably exploit synchronization bugs via segmentation faults. No assigned CVE; developer-hardening concern.

attacks.name: BOOMERANG
attacks.impact: Confused deputy attack breaks most commercial TEEs
attacks.mitigation: TEE runtime hardening
attacks.boundary_statement: BOOMERANG is a confused deputy attack that breaks most commercial TEE platforms. No assigned CVE; runtime-design concern.

attacks.name: BadRAM
attacks.impact: Bypasses SEV-SNP, fakes attestation, inserts backdoors via rogue SPD chip
attacks.mitigation: AMD firmware updates to validate SPD metadata at boot
attacks.boundary_statement: BadRAM affects AMD SEV-SNP via rogue SPD chip on DIMM. Intel TDX has alias checking countermeasures. AMD issued firmware patches.

attacks.name: Battering RAM
attacks.impact: Breaks SGX and SEV-SNP via malicious DRAM interposer
attacks.mitigation: Physical DRAM interposition excluded from threat model; physical access controls
attacks.boundary_statement: Battering RAM (CVE-2025-20955) breaks Intel SGX and AMD SEV-SNP with a $50 malicious DRAM interposer. Requires physical access.

attacks.name: BunnyHop-Reload
attacks.impact: Branch target buffer attack via instruction prefetcher; breaks elliptic curve secp256k1 in SGX
attacks.mitigation: BTB isolation, constant-time branch prediction, microcode update
attacks.boundary_statement: BunnyHop-Reload uses the instruction prefetcher to encode BTB predictions as cache state, enabling Flush+Reload on branch predictor. No assigned CVE; microcode/ISA hardening.

attacks.name: CIPHERLEAKs
attacks.impact: Side-channel inferring secret register values from VMSA in SEV-SNP
attacks.mitigation: Cache partitioning, constant-time code
attacks.boundary_statement: CIPHERLEAKs (CVE-2021-46744) infers secret register values from the VM Save Area in AMD SEV-SNP.

attacks.name: CLKscrew
attacks.impact: Software-controlled DVFS fault injection breaks ARM TrustZone; extracts AES keys and loads self-signed code
attacks.mitigation: Lock voltage/frequency controls; security-aware energy management
attacks.boundary_statement: CLKscrew exploits security-oblivious energy management to inject faults into ARM TrustZone purely from software. No assigned CVE; device-specific firmware issue.

attacks.name: CSV Cryptographic Primitive Risk
attacks.impact: Use of Chinese national cryptographic algorithms (SM2/SM3/SM4) may not be FIPS-compliant or interoperable with global attestation toolchains
attacks.mitigation: Dual-algorithm support; exportable verification using open-source SMx implementations
attacks.boundary_statement: Hygon CSV uses Chinese national crypto standards (SM2/SM3/SM4) which differ from the global FIPS/NIST cryptographic baseline. Attestation verification requires SMx algorithm support. No assigned CVE as of mid-2025.

attacks.name: CacheOut
attacks.impact: MDS side-channel breaks Intel SGX
attacks.mitigation: Cache partitioning, constant-time code
attacks.boundary_statement: CacheOut (CVE-2020-0549 / L1D Eviction Sampling) is an MDS side-channel attack on Intel SGX.

attacks.name: CacheZoom
attacks.impact: L1 Prime+Probe tracks all SGX memory accesses; recovers AES keys with as few as 10 measurements
attacks.mitigation: Cache partitioning, constant-time code, disable hyperthreading
attacks.boundary_statement: CacheZoom combines L1 Prime+Probe with OS-level interrupt control to achieve high-resolution side-channel on SGX enclaves. No assigned CVE; mitigated via constant-time coding.

attacks.name: CounterSEVeillance
attacks.impact: Infers secret data from performance counters
attacks.mitigation: Disable performance counters in TEE; performance impact
attacks.boundary_statement: CounterSEVeillance uses performance counter side-channels on AMD SEV-SNP to infer secret data. No assigned CVE as of mid-2025; treated as design-limitation disclosure.

attacks.name: Dark-ROP
attacks.impact: ROP attack on encrypted SGX binaries using oracles; exfiltrates enclave code, data, and crypto keys
attacks.mitigation: Fine-grained ASLR (SGX-Shield), CFI, W^X, reduce TCB
attacks.boundary_statement: Dark-ROP exploits memory corruption in SGX enclaves via return-oriented programming, completely disarming SGX security guarantees. No assigned CVE; developer-hardening concern.

attacks.name: Devlore
attacks.impact: Device interrupt injection from malicious hypervisor breaks ARM CCA CVM confidentiality and integrity
attacks.mitigation: Interrupt isolation redesign in Realm Management Monitor (RMM); delegate-but-check strategy
attacks.boundary_statement: Devlore demonstrates that a malicious hypervisor can inject device interrupts into ARM CCA confidential VMs via the GIC interrupt controller, compromising execution integrity. No assigned CVE as of mid-2025.

attacks.name: Downfall
attacks.impact: Speculative execution vulnerability breaks Intel SGX
attacks.mitigation: Microcode updates, compiler barriers; performance impact
attacks.boundary_statement: Downfall (CVE-2022-40982 / Gather Data Sampling) is a speculative execution vulnerability affecting Intel SGX.

attacks.name: Foreshadow
attacks.impact: Spectre variant breaks Intel SGX via side-channel
attacks.mitigation: Microcode updates, compiler barriers
attacks.boundary_statement: Foreshadow (CVE-2018-3615 / L1 Terminal Fault) is a Spectre variant that breaks Intel SGX.

attacks.name: Heckler
attacks.impact: Ahoi attack exploiting interrupts/signals breaks SEV-SNP and TDX
attacks.mitigation: Kernel hardening against injected interrupts; TDX blocks low-vector interrupts; SEV-SNP relies on kernel config
attacks.boundary_statement: Heckler (CVE-2024-25743) is an Ahoi attack exploiting injected interrupts/signals to break AMD SEV-SNP and Intel TDX.

attacks.name: Heracles
attacks.impact: Chosen plaintext attack breaks SEV-SNP memory encryption
attacks.mitigation: Memory encryption redesign required
attacks.boundary_statement: Heracles is a chosen plaintext attack on AMD SEV-SNP that breaks memory encryption. No assigned CVE; treated as academic design-limitation disclosure.

attacks.name: IBM SE Boot Image Replay
attacks.impact: Replay of signed boot images could bypass Secure Execution integrity guarantees if attestation freshness is not enforced
attacks.mitigation: Nonce-based attestation freshness, short-lived attestation records
attacks.boundary_statement: IBM Secure Execution attestation records must include freshness mechanisms (nonce/TTL) to prevent replay of captured boot measurements. No assigned CVE as of mid-2025.

attacks.name: MDPeek
attacks.impact: Side-channel attack (MBB) breaks Intel SGX
attacks.mitigation: Cache partitioning, constant-time code
attacks.boundary_statement: MDPeek is a side-channel attack on Intel SGX using MBB technique. No assigned CVE; best addressed via constant-time software practices.

attacks.name: MemJam
attacks.impact: Sub-cache-line timing attack via 4k-aliasing false dependency; breaks constant-time AES in SGX SDK
attacks.mitigation: Cache partitioning, constant-time code at sub-cache-line granularity
attacks.boundary_statement: MemJam exploits false read-after-write dependency to create intra-cache-line timing channel against constant-time crypto in SGX. No assigned CVE; mitigated via constant-time coding.

attacks.name: NanoZone
attacks.impact: Intra-VM isolation gap leaves ARM CCA vulnerable to Heartbleed-style bugs and kernel-space privilege escalation within a CVM
attacks.mitigation: Fine-grained memory protection zones with code-pointer integrity (CPI); ~20% performance overhead
attacks.boundary_statement: NanoZone shows ARM CCA isolates at CVM granularity only, leaving intra-VM memory-safety bugs and kernel-space adversaries within a Realm unmitigated. No assigned CVE as of mid-2025.

attacks.name: Nemesis
attacks.impact: Interrupt timing side-channel leaks instruction-granular execution state from SGX and SEV enclaves
attacks.mitigation: Constant-time interrupt handling; microcode redesign of interrupt latency
attacks.boundary_statement: Nemesis abuses CPU interrupt mechanism to leak microarchitectural instruction timings from hardware-enforced enclaves. No assigned CVE; mitigated via constant-time interrupt handling.

attacks.name: NightVision
attacks.impact: Extracts program counter traces from SGX enclaves, enabling reverse-engineering of private programs
attacks.mitigation: Code obfuscation, constant control flow, or encrypted enclave code
attacks.boundary_statement: NightVision uses non-volatile side-channels to extract dynamic PC traces from SGX enclaves, breaking code confidentiality. No assigned CVE; mitigated via code-hardening practices.

attacks.name: PCC Path Traversal
attacks.impact: Privileged network attacker can leak sensitive user data from Apple PCC nodes via path traversal
attacks.mitigation: Input validation fixes in PCC Release 5E290.3
attacks.boundary_statement: CVE-2026-20685 is a path traversal vulnerability in Apple Private Cloud Compute allowing a privileged network attacker to leak sensitive request data. Fixed in PCC Release 5E290.3.

attacks.name: PCC TGT Validation Bypass
attacks.impact: Token validation gap allows forged request tokens; PCC Node does not validate TGT signature despite code existing for it
attacks.mitigation: Enable TGT signature validation in PCC Node production builds
attacks.boundary_statement: Apple PCC Node currently skips TGT (Token Grant Token) signature validation even though the check exists in source code. Attackers still need a valid OTT to exploit. No assigned CVE as of mid-2025.

attacks.name: Plundervolt
attacks.impact: Software-based voltage control breaks Intel SGX
attacks.mitigation: Lock voltage controls; BIOS/firmware fix
attacks.boundary_statement: Plundervolt (CVE-2019-11157) exploits software-exposed energy management mechanisms to break Intel SGX.

attacks.name: RMPocalypse
attacks.impact: Single 8-byte write corrupts entire RMP (Reverse Map Table), breaking SEV-SNP memory isolation
attacks.mitigation: RMP table integrity validation required; fundamental SEV-SNP redesign; follow AMD PSP/SEV firmware advisories
attacks.boundary_statement: RMPocalypse (CVE-2025-22919) corrupts AMD SEV-SNP's Reverse Map Table with a single 8-byte write, breaking all memory isolation guarantees. Awaiting vendor patch-SVN guidance.

attacks.name: SEV-Step
attacks.impact: Single-stepping framework for AMD SEV; leaks LUKS2 disk keys and enables Nemesis-style attacks on SEV VMs
attacks.mitigation: Disable debug API, constant-time code, cache partitioning
attacks.boundary_statement: SEV-Step demonstrates that AMD SEV VMs can be reliably single-stepped, enabling the same microarchitectural attacks as SGX-Step. No assigned CVE; operational-hardening concern.

attacks.name: SEVered
attacks.impact: Page-remapping attack breaks AMD SEV
attacks.mitigation: SEV-SNP introduced RMP table to prevent; BadRAM bypasses RMP
attacks.boundary_statement: SEVered (CVE-2019-9836) is a page-remapping attack on AMD SEV. SEV-SNP introduced RMP table but BadRAM bypasses it.

attacks.name: SGAxe
attacks.impact: Transient execution, side-channel breaks Intel SGX
attacks.mitigation: Microcode updates, compiler barriers
attacks.boundary_statement: SGAxe (CVE-2020-0547 / CacheOut derivative) is a transient execution attack on Intel SGX.

attacks.name: SGX-Bomb
attacks.impact: Rowhammer-induced bit flips in enclave memory trigger processor lockdown, causing system-wide DoS
attacks.mitigation: Rowhammer-free DRAM or TRR; SGX integrity check redesign
attacks.boundary_statement: SGX-Bomb uses Rowhammer to trigger SGX integrity violations, locking the processor and requiring a full system reboot. No assigned CVE; DRAM-level reliability issue.

attacks.name: SGX-ROP
attacks.impact: Enclave malware with ROP fully impersonates host application
attacks.mitigation: Code hardening, CFI, W^X
attacks.boundary_statement: SGX-ROP demonstrates enclave malware that fully and stealthily impersonates its host application. No assigned CVE; developer-hardening concern.

attacks.name: SGX-Step
attacks.impact: Precise enclave execution control attack framework
attacks.mitigation: Cache partitioning, constant-time code
attacks.boundary_statement: SGX-Step provides a practical attack framework for precise enclave execution control. No assigned CVE; operational-hardening and constant-time-coding concern.

attacks.name: SgxPectre
attacks.impact: Spectre variant for SGX; steals seal keys and attestation keys from Intel quoting enclaves
attacks.mitigation: Microcode updates, compiler barriers (LFENCE), retpoline
attacks.boundary_statement: SgxPectre (CVE-2017-5753 / Spectre v1 variant) exploits speculative execution to leak enclave secrets including attestation keys, completely defeating SGX confidentiality.

attacks.name: Sigy
attacks.impact: Ahoi attack exploiting interrupts/signals breaks SGX
attacks.mitigation: Interrupt handling redesign
attacks.boundary_statement: Sigy (CVE-2024-25746) is an Ahoi attack exploiting injected signals to break Intel SGX.

attacks.name: TEE.fail
attacks.impact: Breaks all CC guarantees via DDR5 bus interposition
attacks.mitigation: Physical DRAM interposition excluded from threat model
attacks.boundary_statement: Intel TDX / AMD SEV-SNP threat model excludes physical DRAM interposition. DDR5 bus interposition demonstrated with ~$1,000 hardware.

attacks.name: TeeJam
attacks.impact: Sub-cache-line leakage via 4k-aliasing + SGX single-stepping; breaks AES T-Table and recovers 4096-bit RSA keys
attacks.mitigation: Cache partitioning, constant-time code at sub-cache-line granularity
attacks.boundary_statement: TeeJam combines 4k-aliasing with SGX single-stepping to achieve 4-byte intra-cache-line resolution, breaking constant-time crypto implementations. No assigned CVE; mitigated via constant-time coding.

attacks.name: TeeRex
attacks.impact: Automated discovery of memory corruption at host-to-enclave boundary; found vulnerabilities in Intel, Baidu, WolfSSL, Synaptics enclaves
attacks.mitigation: Strict pointer validation at enclave boundary, symbolic execution testing, reduce TCB
attacks.boundary_statement: TeeRex reveals that exploitable memory corruption vulnerabilities are easily introduced at the SGX host-to-enclave boundary. No assigned CVE; developer-hardening concern.

attacks.name: VMScape
attacks.impact: Breaks virtualization boundaries on AMD Zen CPUs and Intel Coffee Lake
attacks.mitigation: Hypervisor-level isolation hardening; CPU microcode updates
attacks.boundary_statement: VMScape (CVE-2025-40300) breaks virtualization boundaries on AMD Zen and Intel Coffee Lake, affecting TEE isolation guarantees.

attacks.name: VoltJockey
attacks.impact: Software-controlled voltage-induced hardware faults break SGX; extracts AES keys and forges RSA signatures
attacks.mitigation: Lock voltage controls via BIOS/firmware; disable DVFS for untrusted OS
attacks.boundary_statement: VoltJockey (CVE-2019-11157 / shares Plundervolt voltage-fault root cause) exploits DVFS to inject voltage-oriented hardware faults into SGX enclaves, controlled by software.

attacks.name: WeSee
attacks.impact: Ahoi attack exploiting malicious #VC interrupts breaks SEV-SNP
attacks.mitigation: Kernel #VC handler validation; protected interrupt delivery
attacks.boundary_statement: WeSee (CVE-2024-25745) injects malicious #VC interrupts to break AMD SEV-SNP.

attacks.name: WireTap
attacks.impact: Breaks Intel SGX via malicious DRAM interposer
attacks.mitigation: Physical DRAM interposition excluded from threat model; physical access controls
attacks.boundary_statement: WireTap breaks Intel SGX with a malicious DRAM interposer. No assigned CVE; physical-access attack outside standard cloud threat model.

attacks.name: ÆPIC Leak
attacks.impact: Architectural attack exploiting undefined APIC register breaks SGX
attacks.mitigation: Microcode redesign; fundamental hardware change
attacks.boundary_statement: ÆPIC Leak (CVE-2022-21233) is an architectural attack on Intel SGX exploiting undefined APIC register.
